identification: Three small brown and gold (honey/brown drip-glazed) Tasmanian pottery vases, the cylinder/waisted vase signed in script on base 'H McHugh Tasmania 3' (H. McHugh, Launceston, 1930s, shape no. 3); the small bulb vase has an indistinct scrawled base inscription (appears McHugh) and a third squat flared vase has a dark stylised/ink mark on base. Condition issues: large chip/loss to rim of the squat vase, rim glaze loss/flaking to the cylinder vase. Lot title says 'all as is'.

viewing_check: Estimate 20-30, no current bid shown. Check chip to squat vase rim, flaking glaze on cylinder rim, and whether the small bulb vase and squat vase are really McHugh (marks unclear). Sold prices span Nov 2023 to Jun 2026, steady, no clear trend. Damaged small McHugh vases sell about A$27-60 each; sound mid-size A$70-120; large or rare numbers A$150-650.
